title: Operations New Bulk Email Entry Permission Consistency

items.action: open and select generic operation creation entries
authorize the Bulk Email business flow for the new-operation entry
load the mandatory mail-template selector in the Bulk Email wizard
load the mandatory sender-account selector in the Bulk Email wizard

backend.reason: Bulk Email immediate create/start authorization already uses fair_crm.fair_emails.execute.

api.reason: No API contract changes; wizard metadata and operation-type reads already use existing read access.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The Bulk Email wizard route and Operations-page type picker both require fair_crm.fair_emails.execute plus the mandatory mail_templates.read and email_accounts.read lookup prerequisites.

forms.reason: No business form behavior changes; the type picker only filters unauthorized operation types.

notes: Bulk Email entry from /operations requires fair_crm.fair_emails.execute plus fair_crm.mail_templates.read and fair_crm.email_accounts.read because both lookups are mandatory wizard prerequisites. This entry still does not require fair_crm.operations.create, and already-created Bulk Email Start/Retry plus final Send continue to use fair_crm.fair_emails.execute without adding these read permissions to the mutation boundary. Generic operation entries retain their existing permission behavior. The type picker and deep-link route use equivalent fail-closed prerequisites.
